summary_en: KOITO MANUFACTURING executed an off-hours block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on 29 October 2026, acquiring 3.0 million shares at 2,508.5 yen per share for a total of 7.5255 billion yen, representing 1.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Repurchase of Treasury Shares through Off-Hours Block Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On 28 October 2026, KOITO MANUFACTURING announced the execution of a treasury share repurchase through an off-hours block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company acquired 3,000,000 shares at 2,508.5 yen per share, the closing price on the announcement date, for a total outlay of 7,525.5 million yen. This transaction represented 1.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury shares.

The repurchase was conducted under the framework of a board authorization dated 29 May 2026, which approved a buyback program with a maximum size of 25 million shares (9.50% of outstanding shares) and a budget ceiling of 5.0 billion yen over the period from 1 June 2026 to 31 May 2027. The acquisition method specified in the authorization included ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block trades and open market purchases.

The company stated that the repurchase was undertaken as part of its fundamental policy to enhance corporate value through sustained business investment supporting growth, while simultaneously improving capital returns to shareholders.
